paragraphs: R' Yonatan son of Elazar, man of HaBirah.
See the entry "R' Yonatan, man of HaBirah."[^1]

notes.text: The heading includes son of Elazar, while the target omits that patronymic. HaBirah is retained without identifying a place or settling the exact attachment of the designation. The heading was recorded as provisional; both abbreviated titles remain R'. No title is added to Elazar.
